Yes, this first half feels right. Archiving "Recipes I want to try" took it out of my main list, bumped the Archived count to one, and the top still says three bookmarks kept — so it's tucked away rather than thrown out, which is just what I wanted. The note that archived items stay out of this view and normal search matches my idea of putting something out of sight without losing it. And the "Moved to Archived — Undo" gives me a way back if I didn't mean to. 

The other half I'd want to see is the return trip: going into that Archived list, finding this bookmark still whole with its labels and note, and being able to bring it back into the main collection. Can you show me that next?
